args: dirs = ENV["PATH"].to_s.split(File::PATH_SEPARATOR).map { |dir| File.dirname(dir) }.select { |dir| File.directory?(File.join(dir, "specifications")) }.uniq; ENV["GEM_PATH"] = [*dirs, ""].join(File::PATH_SEPARATOR) if dirs.any? && ENV["GEM_PATH"].to_s.empty? && ENV["GEM_HOME"].to_s.empty?; exec(*ARGV)
